Derived from playwright_wordmark.svg (Wikimedia Commons, Apache-2.0, artist Microsoft). Two changes, both recorded: (1) wrapped on a 952x952 square canvas with the wordmark centred at y=380, because AssetIcon renders img: assets in a square box with objectFit:cover and would otherwise crop a 5:1 wordmark; (2) the wordmark TEXT path fill #111111 recoloured to #FFFFFF for legibility on dark themes — this matches Playwright official dark-background usage on playwright.dev. Mask artwork and all mask colours unaltered.
